description: ikOrientToWorld and ikAlignToPole turn each handle about Y only, so +Z faces its pole. Left: end (6,0,0), pole (2.8+0.7, 2.4+2.6, 3) = (3.5,5,3), so the horizontal line is (-2.5,0,3) and the turn is atan2(-2.5, 3) = -39.805571. The right is the reflection with its pole X negated by D28, (2.5,0,3), so the turn is equal and opposite.
